name: etfholdingextractor-161
description: Agent for extracting ETF holdings weights from supported providers, planning or syncing MainSequence HOLDINGS__<ETF> asset categories (FIGI-registering missing components on demand), and publishing ms-markets ETF-tracking portfolios through the repository CLI and library surfaces.

skills.name: ETF Holdings Weights Extraction
skills.description: Extract ETF holdings weights from supported provider fund URLs or explicit provider and ticker inputs.
examples: Extract ticker weights for IVV from iShares.
Read holdings weights from a supported ETF fund URL.

skills.name: Holdings Category Sync
skills.description: Build or sync a MainSequence holdings asset category from extracted ETF holdings, FIGI-registering missing components on demand (ADR 0004: FIGI-keyed, unique ticker-to-FIGI mappings only).
examples: Build a holdings category plan for IVV.
Sync the HOLDINGS__IVV category from extracted holdings.
FIGI-register the missing IVV components and re-sync the category.

skills.name: ETF-Tracking Portfolio
skills.description: Publish an ms-markets portfolio that tracks an ETF: a guarded holdings signal (session-close observations, daily throttle, change-only inserts with validity re-stamp) wired into PortfoliosDataNode with a persisted trading calendar attached to the Portfolio row by FK and a 60-day backtest bootstrap.
examples: Publish an IVV tracking portfolio with the NYSE calendar.
Run the self-sufficient IVV tracking-portfolio example end to end.
Re-run the tracker and verify portfolio values and weights on the platform.
